newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen consolidating gains.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen consolidating gains.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to consolidate Wednesday's gains ahead of the weekend, brokers said.

"The market will continue to recover from a prolonged bear run. Most of the blue chip shares have become attractive," said broker Sabbir Ahmed. Brokers said scrips in engineering, cement and leather might be specially attractive to retail investors.
The DSE all-share price index gained 10.77 points, or 1.08 percent, to 1,007.27 on turnover of 42.5 million taka on Wednesday.
